name: 宝宝树孕育
text:
#!name=宝宝树孕育
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule


[Rule]
URL-REGEX,"^http:\/\/go\.babytree\.com\/go_pregnancy\/api\/(index_activity\/get_app_index_activity|sign\/sign_h_5)\?",REJECT-TINYGIF,extended-matching
URL-REGEX,"^http:\/\/go\.babytree\.com\/go_search\/api\/mobile_search_new\/get_multi_search_default_keywords\?",REJECT-TINYGIF,extended-matching
URL-REGEX,"^http:\/\/m\.meitun\.com\/newapi\/router\/topic\/hometptf\/feedRecommend",REJECT-TINYGIF,extended-matching
URL-REGEX,"^http:\/\/pic08\.babytreeimg\.com\/knowledge\/2022\/0923\/\w+",REJECT,extended-matching
URL-REGEX,"^http:\/\/plough\.babytree\.com\/plough\.do",REJECT-TINYGIF,extended-matching

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/aimg\.babytreeimg\.com\/group1\/M00\/*\/*\/.*.jpg/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/plough\.babytree\.com\/plough\.do/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mapiweb\.babytree\.com\/newapi\/luban\/behavior\/receive/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/go\.babytree\.com\/go_pregnancy\/api\/index_activity\/get_app_index_activity/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/go\.babytree\.com\/go_tool\/api\/feeding_record\/get_home_banner_info/i then reject_dict(200)

[Script]
调整整体配置 = type=http-response, pattern=^http:\/\/api\.babytree\.com\/bafconfigcenter_intf\/config\/get\?, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/BabyTree/BabyTree_remove_ads.js, requires-body=true
移除各页面推广 = type=http-response, pattern=^http:\/\/go\.babytree\.com\/go_pregnancy\/api\/(app_index\/get_app_tab|cms_column\/get_column_list|feeds\/get_index_feeds_list|user\/get_user_info)\?, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/BabyTree/BabyTree_remove_ads.js, requires-body=true
移除搜索列表推广 = type=http-response, pattern=^http:\/\/go\.babytree\.com\/go_search\/api\/mobile_search_new\/search_index, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/BabyTree/BabyTree_remove_ads.js, requires-body=true

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% aimg.babytreeimg.com, plough.babytree.com, mapiweb.babytree.com, go.babytree.com, api.babytree.com
